objective: Closed-set image provenance: identify the registered source of a generatively edited image.
inference_inputs: TrustMark decoded payload mapped to catalog
ground_truth_use: Evaluation only. Never use the true source to select a prediction.
candidate_rules: If mapped TrustMark and DINOv2 agree, accept their source.
If they disagree, flag conflict. Choose the final action using development data, not test data.
If TrustMark is unavailable, use calibrated DINOv2 reliability. Abstain when evidence is insufficient.
calibration: Fit and select thresholds on development data with source-disjoint splits. Evaluate on untouched test sources whose references are present in the fixed catalog.
limitations: No threshold estimated in this step
